name: scenario_0355
description: The user is organizing a luxury showcase event and has collected images of specific furniture and high-end cars they want to feature. They are using their assistant to compile a sourcing list and notify the event coordinator.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5]
Query: Create a new Todoist project called 'Luxury Showcase'. Then, add a task to acquire the specific furniture items listed on the wall in the first image.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a Todoist project named 'Luxury Showcase' and add a task to acquire the specific furniture items listed on the wall in the first image. If the assistant asks for clarification on the items, tell it to read the names off the wall next to the '05'. Once confirmed, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Now add another task to that project to source the two Ferraris whose interiors are shown in the second and third images.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to add a task to the project to source the two Ferrari models shown in the second and third images. If the assistant needs to search to confirm the exact models, allow it to do so. Once it has added the task with the correct models, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Add a third task to source the Jaguar XF and the green Aston Martin DB11 shown in the last two pictures.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to add a third task to source the cars in the last two images, but intentionally misidentify them as a 'Jaguar XF' and an 'Aston Martin DB11'. A good assistant should notice from the images that your identification is incorrect. If the assistant flags this mistake, acknowledge it. If it blindly adds the wrong models, prepare to correct it in the next round.

ROUND 4
Query: Oops, you're right, my mistake. Please update that last task to reflect the correct models for the cars in those last two pictures.
Instructions: Acknowledge the mistake regarding the car models. Instruct the assistant to update the task it just created so that it lists the actual correct models shown in the last two images. Once the task is updated, move to the next round.

ROUND 5
Query: Finally, pull up all the tasks in the 'Luxury Showcase' project and send a text message to our event coordinator, Sarah Jenkins, summarizing all the furniture and cars we need to source.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to retrieve all the tasks from the 'Luxury Showcase' project and send a text message to the event coordinator, Sarah Jenkins. The message should summarize all the furniture and car models we need to source based on the project tasks. Once the message is sent, end the conversation.

entity_data.message: Hi Sarah, for the Luxury Showcase we need to source the following furniture: Poltrona Derby, Divano Gamma, Tavolino Loto, and Tavolino Ninfea. We also need to source these cars: Ferrari SF90, Ferrari 348, Jaguar XEL, and Aston Martin DB12.

entity_data.title: Acquire Poltrona Derby, Divano Gamma, Tavolino Loto, and Tavolino Ninfea
Source Jaguar XEL and Aston Martin DB12

task_completion_criteria: Create a Todoist project named 'Luxury Showcase' containing three tasks: one to acquire the 'Poltrona Derby', 'Divano Gamma', 'Tavolino Loto', and 'Tavolino Ninfea' furniture items; one to source a Ferrari SF90 and a Ferrari 348; and one to source a Jaguar XEL and an Aston Martin DB12. Then, send a text message to Sarah Jenkins summarizing these exact furniture items and car models.
